items.exampleEn: With great determination, she finished the race.
items.exampleZh: 她憑著堅強的決心跑完了比賽。

items.exampleEn: Try to make a rational decision when you are angry.
items.exampleZh: 生氣時，試著做出理性的決定。

items.exampleEn: This restaurant is supposedly the best in town.
items.exampleZh: 據說這家餐廳是鎮上最好的。

items.exampleEn: Her only objection was the price.
The last part of the climb was the most challenging.
items.exampleZh: 爬山的最後一段最有挑戰性。

items.exampleEn: The probability of rain tomorrow is low.
She wants to become a philosopher one day.
items.exampleZh: 她希望有一天能成為哲學家。

items.exampleEn: It is wrong to judge people by prejudice.
items.exampleZh: 用偏見來評斷別人是不對的。

items.sentenceEn: This job is challenging, but I enjoy it.
items.sentenceZh: 這份工作很有挑戰性，但我很喜歡。

items.audioEn: The old castle is supposedly three hundred years old, but nobody really knows.
items.audioZh: 據說那座古堡有三百年歷史，但沒人真的知道。
items.questionZh: 關於古堡的年代，說話者怎麼說？
options: It was built last century by a king.
It is three hundred years old for sure.
It may be three hundred years old.

items.sentenceEn: There is a high probability that he will be late.
My parents had no objection to my trip.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸媽不反對我去旅行。

items.stemEn: Her ____ to win helped her train every day, even in the rain.
items.stemZh: 她想贏的決心讓她每天都練習，連下雨也不例外。

items.stemEn: This math problem is very ____, but I think I can solve it.
items.stemZh: 這道數學題很有挑戰性，但我想我解得出來。

items.passageEn: Our teacher once told us about a philosopher who said, "A rational person changes his mind when he learns new facts." Supposedly, he said this more than two thousand years ago. Last month, I joined a debate club, and I found debating very challenging. In my first debate, I had a prejudice against the other team because they were younger. But their speeches were remarkable, and the probability that we would win became lower and lower. When I raised an objection, the judge said my point was not rational. We lost, but I learned a lot. Now I practice with great determination.
items.passageZh: 老師曾告訴我們一位哲學家說過的話：「理性的人在得知新的事實後會改變想法。」據說這句話是他兩千多年前說的。上個月，我參加了辯論社，發現辯論非常有挑戰性。在我第一場辯論中，我對另一隊有偏見，因為他們比較年輕。但他們的演講非常出色，我們贏的機率也越來越低。當我提出反對意見時，評審說我的論點不夠理性。我們輸了，但我學到很多。現在，我帶著堅強的決心練習。

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼對另一隊有偏見？
options: 因為他們的老師很嚴格
因為他們來自很遠的學校
因為他們上次贏了很多次

questions.questionZh: 評審對作者的反對意見說了什麼？
options: 聲音太小了，大家都聽不清楚
說得非常好而且很有道理

referenceEn: It is supposedly going to snow tomorrow.
rubricZh: supposedly 表示「據說」，例如 Supposedly, … 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說未來的事用 will、be going to 等）

items.promptZh: 照顧三個小孩對她來說很有挑戰性。
referenceEn: Looking after three kids is challenging for her.
Taking care of three children is really challenging for her.
rubricZh: 用 challenging 表示「有挑戰性的」
「照顧」可寫，例如 looking after、taking care of 等
